policy: Single unblinded qualitative review of all contradictory-evidence replies, with exact text identifiers and labels preserved. Explicit correct revision requires a correct reference to the initial/original assessment being overturned, superseded, corrected, or no longer best. Merely stating the new answer is not counted. Historical reversal means describing the new explanation as the initial explanation. These labels screen a behavior candidate; no independent rater, hidden-state attribution or unique cognitive capability is established.
scope: Six supplied fictional starting hypotheses, two developed histories, one natural-response wording, one common sampling stream (202). The initial hypothesis was supplied in the prompt, not independently generated by the model. Repeated baseline replies across histories are duplicates.
